sources: https://floridardr.usedirect.com/FloridaRDR/rdr/search/place (PlaceId 40) and search/grid (facilities 107 Loop 1, 108 Loop 2), the API behind https://reserve.floridastateparks.org/Web/#!park/40

values.note: $29 a night for an RV: the $22 campsite fee plus a $7 nightly utility fee for RV units (tent camping $22), plus tax and a nonrefundable $6.70 reservation fee. Florida residents 65 and over, or holding a Social Security or 100% federal disability certificate, get 50% off the base campsite fee. Day visitors pay $5 a vehicle. Read 2026-10-20.

fees.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/lake-manatee-state-park/hours-fees ('$22 per night plus tax, plus a nonrefundable $6.70 reservation fee and a $7 nightly utility fee for RV ... units') + Reserve Florida 'Starting at $22.00' on both loops, read 2026-10-20

hookups.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/lake-manatee-state-park/experiences-amenities-0#camping ('Water and 30-amp electricity are available at every site'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Dump station at the campground entrance; restrooms near the sites.

facilities.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/lake-manatee-state-park/experiences-amenities-0#camping ('A dump station is located at the entrance of the campground'; accessible amenities: 'Campsites with concrete pad, picnic table, ground grill and nearby restrooms'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 60-site camping area on concrete pads; Reserve Florida lists 54 bookable units in two loops, 45-65 ft.

sites.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/lake-manatee-state-park/experiences-amenities-0#camping ('A 60-site camping area', 'Maximum RV length = 65 ft.') + Reserve Florida search/grid for facilities 107 and 108, read 2026-10-20

values.note: Reserve Florida (reserve.floridastateparks.org) or 800-326-3521. The park page says reservations open up to 11 months ahead; Reserve Florida, queried without a Florida-resident account, offered dates to 2027-08-20 (10 months) on 2026-10-20, consistent with Florida's shorter non-resident window. Its booking restrictions give a 1-night minimum and 14-night maximum for both loops.

booking.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/lake-manatee-state-park/experiences-amenities-0#camping ('Reservations can be made up to 11 months in advance') + Reserve Florida search/place PlaceId 40 Restrictions (FutureBookingEnds 2027-08-20, MinimumStay 1, MaximumStay 14), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed $29 ($22 + $7 RV utility fee) and the $6.70 reservation fee on the park's fee page. Added 30-amp electric and water at every site, dump station, 60 sites with a 65-ft max RV length, and booking on Reserve Florida (usedirect, not 'operator'), 11-month window, 14-night max. Not stated: sewer, showers for campers (only implied), pull-throughs, season, fcfs.
